ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized to scars and water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity distribution across the majority of the visible fluke surface; localized high-contrast linear segments and point-clusters corresponding to surface marks and water droplets.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness with variable pixel-amplitude; most pronounced on the terminal section of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; initial concave sweep from the notch transitioning to convex towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several discrete, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions; one prominent diagonal mark on the left lobe and smaller, unaligned marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-uniform indentation and loss of marginal continuity at the distal tip of the left fluke lobe.
